subject: history
concept: Synthesizing evidence from multiple sources to construct an original historical argument about the ancient-to-medieval period
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student organizes evidence from at least three sources into a single argument-support chart
exercise.abstract: Student writes a paragraph synthesizing multiple sources to support an original historical claim

assessment.mastery_threshold: paragraph integrates evidence from multiple distinct sources in support of one coherent original claim
misconception_flags: discusses each source separately rather than genuinely synthesizing them into one argument

interest_binding: sources generated fresh from student's stated interest profile where possible
